titulo.estudio: うち に と あいだ に
titulo.alumno: Distinguishing うちに from 間に

intro: Look at the pattern in short examples and check what information it adds in context.

palabras.significado: let's get it prepared in advance

piezas.titulo: うちに highlights an opportunity that may disappear; 間に places an event within an interval.
texto: 若いうちに (while still young); 留守の間に (during the absence). The sense of opportunity guides the choice.
記憶 が 新しいうち に、内容 を 記録 して おきましょう。 (While the memory is still fresh, let's get the content recorded in advance.)
担当者 が 留守 の あいだ に、資料 が 届きました。 (The materials arrived while the person in charge was away.)
